Image Registry, Tags and Digests
A registry stores images; a tag is a movable label; a digest identifies image content.
Registry එක images store කරනවා. Tag එක version label එකක්; Jවන image එකකට move
Jවන්න පුළුවන්. Digest එක content identity එකක්.
CI pushes an image, staging and production pull the same digest.
